screen27-a3.initial_rationale: no visible word; the glyph is the Facebook brand mark, which a first-time user widely reads as 'go to Facebook'; exemption pending a tap
screen27-a3.deciding_evidence: tapping the Facebook mark launched the Facebook app (its own notification prompt appeared), so the brand mark did what it shows [test run once on screen1-a3 and carried to this duplicate - same control type and appearance]

screen27-a4.deciding_evidence: tapping the banner opened Android's notification settings page for Messenger, as the sentence says [test run once on screen1-a4 and carried to this duplicate - same control type and appearance]

screen27-a5.description: control showing 'Ask Meta AI or search'
screen27-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc 'Ask Meta AI or search' - read only to know what to test for; not used in the verdict
screen27-a5.initial_rationale: the only text is the placeholder 'Ask Meta AI or search', which names two different jobs in one field and does not say what is searched; it is gone once typing starts
screen27-a5.deciding_evidence: a typed question was treated as a people search (accounts whose names resemble the words); reaching Meta AI needs a separate 'Ask' chip that only appears after typing, and the placeholder vanished on the first keystroke [test run once on screen1-a5 and carried to this duplicate - same control type and appearance]
screen27-a5.recommendation: give the field a persistent label such as 'Search people and chats' and a separate, always-visible 'Ask Meta AI' button, instead of one placeholder naming both jobs

screen27-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc 'Your note' - read only to know what to test for; not used in the verdict
screen27-a6.initial_rationale: the bubble shows a prompt phrase ('Drop a thought' / 'What's up?') - an idiom that does not say it posts a public note, or for how long
screen27-a6.deciding_evidence: the bubble opened a 'New note' composer whose footer says 'Anyone can see your note on Messenger and Facebook for 24 hours' - nothing on the bubble said it creates a public post [test run once on screen1-a6 and carried to this duplicate - same control type and appearance]
screen27-a6.recommendation: label the bubble 'Post a note' and say who sees it (e.g. 'Post a note - visible for 24 h')
